about: 회계 II › 수입비용(輸入 — 미착품, E060201 ~ E060210) 흐름 — plans/회계2/수입비용.md 3장 숫자 그대로: 청구서 100,000 → 계산서 20,000(부가세 2,000 자동) → 영수증 10,000 → 지급 100,000 · 관세사 32,000 → 수입관리대장 합계 130,000 → 본계정대체 130,000 → 잔액 빈칸 · 통관일 → 대체 선택삭제('전표를 삭제하겠습니까? - 본계정대체') → 잔액 130,000 → 다섯 장 선택삭제('삭제하겠습니까?'). 관리번호는 API 로 지운다(원본은 삭제 단추 없음).

finally: js:(async()=>{const api=(m,p,b)=>fetch('/api'+p,{method:m,headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:b?JSON.stringify(b):undefined});const code=sessionStorage.getItem('icLot');const lots=await (await api('GET','/import-costs/lots')).json();const lot=lots.find((l)=>l.code===code&&l.name==='QA회계2-수입1');if(!lot)return true;const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const vs=await (await api('GET','/import-costs/vouchers?from=2000-01-01&to=2099-12-31')).json();const ids=vs.filter((v)=>v.lotId===lot.id).map((v)=>v.id);if(ids.length)await api('POST','/import-costs/vouchers/delete',{ids});await api('DELETE','/import-costs/lots/'+lot.id);return true})()
